findings.title: fetch_error_details misaligns errors via zip(events.values())
findings.body: In src/sentry/replays/endpoints/project_replay_summarize_breadcrumbs.py fetch_error_details builds node_ids from error_ids, calls nodestore.get_multi(node_ids), then zips error_ids with events.values(). Dict values order is not guaranteed to match error_ids order, and missing keys are omitted rather than None, so titles/messages/timestamps get attributed to the wrong error id and some errors are dropped/duplicated. The Seer prompt then receives wrong error context. Fix by looking up each node_id in the returned dict.

findings.title: TableWidgetVisualization rendered with empty data
findings.body: In static/app/views/dashboards/widgetCard/chart.tsx when organization.features includes use-table-widget-visualization the code renders TableWidgetVisualization with hardcoded columns={[]} and tableData {data:[], meta:{fields:{}, units:{}}}, discarding result.data, result.meta, fields, and custom renderers computed just above. Enabling the flag turns every dashboard table into an empty table. Wire the real query results into the new visualization.

findings.title: get_merged_pr_single_issue_template calls wrong class
findings.body: In src/sentry/integrations/source_code_management/commit_context.py CommitContextIntegration.get_merged_pr_single_issue_template calls PRCommentWorkflow._truncate_title, but _truncate_title is defined on CommitContextIntegration. This raises AttributeError/NameError at runtime when formatting suspect-issue PR comments for GitHub/GitLab, breaking merged-PR comments. Call the local implementation instead.

findings.title: Mutual-exclusivity check uses truthiness, allows age/timestamp 0
findings.body: In src/sentry/issues/endpoints/browser_reporting_collector.py validate_timestamp checks if self.initial_data.get("age") and validate_age checks if self.initial_data.get("timestamp"). Falsy values like 0 bypass the check, so a report containing both age:0 and timestamp:0 (or timestamp:0 with age) passes validation despite the spec requiring them to be mutually exclusive. Check key presence instead of truthiness.

findings.title: error_ids depends on client field param, error context lost
findings.body: In src/sentry/replays/endpoints/project_replay_summarize_breadcrumbs.py the endpoint calls process_raw_response with fields=request.query_params.getlist("field") and then reads response[0].get("error_ids"). The frontend AI tab calls the endpoint with no field param, so error_ids is empty and fetch_error_details is never populated. The new error-context feature is dead unless callers guess to pass field=error_ids. Explicitly request error_ids for the internal query.

findings.title: Analytics recorded before feature/validation checks
findings.body: In src/sentry/preprod/api/endpoints/organization_preprod_artifact_assemble.py analytics.record for preprod_artifact.api.assemble runs before the organizations:preprod-artifact-assemble feature check and before body validation. Disabled, unauthorized, or malformed requests are counted as assembles, inflating metrics. Move the record call after the feature gate and successful validation.

findings.title: Column fallback crashes when meta.fields is missing
findings.body: In static/app/views/dashboards/widgets/tableWidget/tableWidgetVisualization.tsx the fallback columnOrder does Object.keys(tableData?.meta.fields). If tableData or meta.fields is undefined/null from an empty or malformed response, Object.keys throws TypeError and the whole widget crashes. Guard with fallback to empty object.

findings.title: Header alignment uses display name instead of field key
findings.body: In static/app/views/dashboards/widgets/tableWidget/defaultTableCellRenderers.tsx renderDefaultHeadCell calls fieldAlignment(column.name, ...) while the body renderer uses column.key. When a custom display name is supplied (e.g. Count of Span Duration), alignment is computed from the display string instead of the field type, so numeric columns can be left-aligned. Use column.key for alignment.
